title: Canonical scheme derived adjunction and pullback composition
statement: For schemes, use the unbounded derived pullbacks $Lf^*$ [def-pc-derived-pullback], derived direct images $Rf_*$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image], and ordinary tensor-formula pullbacks $f^*$ with their adjunctions $f^*\dashv f_*$ [def-pc-module-pullback]. Fix a common localization universe and the derived-category localizations for all schemes. Define the canonical choices as follows. Choose once the simultaneous left-derived counits $\epsilon_f:Lf^*Q_Y\to Q_X f^*$ and their composition comparisons supplied by the left-derived universal property, where $Q_X$ denotes localization of the unbounded homotopy category of $\mathcal O_X$-modules. For $f:X\to Y$, define $a_f:Lf^*\dashv Rf_*$ to be the adjunction chosen from the derived adjunction construction with that same counit $\epsilon_f$, the recorded right-derived unit, and the ordinary tensor-pullback adjunction. In particular for homotopy complexes $M$ on $Y$ and $N$ on $X$, its Hom correspondence sends $Q_X(t)\circ\epsilon_f(M)$ to $\eta_f(N)\circ Q_Y(\operatorname{adj}_f(t))$ for $t:f^*M\to N$, where $\operatorname{adj}_f$ is the Hom correspondence of that ordinary adjunction and $\eta_f:Q_Y f_*\to Rf_*Q_X$ is the recorded right-derived unit. For composable $f:X\to Y$ and $g:Y\to Z$, define $c_{f,g}:Lf^*\circ Lg^*\xrightarrow{\sim}L(g\circ f)^*$ to be the composition isomorphism in that same chosen simultaneous family. It is the unique comparison compatible with the counits and the ordinary tensor-pullback compositor, the adjoint mate of the pushforward compositor. These are the fixed choices used for canonical scheme-derived mates; the mate evaluation identity is a separate theorem.
